hook: What happens when a 90-foot natural stone bridge vanishes into the Pacific Ocean in just four days?

sections.voiceover: What happens when a 90-foot natural stone bridge vanishes into the Pacific Ocean in just four days?
b_roll: Wide shot of the coastline in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park

sections.voiceover: Park officials confirmed the Hōlei Sea Arch stood intact on September 23, 2026. Where did the structure go by September 27?
Except a hurricane brushed the southern coastline right before the collapse.
b_roll: Satellite wave motion over the Pacific Ocean

sections.voiceover: A hurricane brushed the southern coastline, causing the Hōlei Sea Arch to collapse into the sea. The 90-foot landmark crashed directly into the Pacific Ocean.
b_roll: Coastal waves crashing against basalt cliffs

sections.voiceover: The 550-year-old lava flow structure is now gone from Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park.
b_roll: Empty ocean horizon at Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park
